name: Shadow Puppetry
visualIdentity: Shadow Puppetry uses readable dark silhouettes on a translucent screen, with distinct depth layers and limited colors. Props stay legible in outline. The source marks this as explicit art direction, normalized from shadow-theatre and paper-silhouette references. Limbs stay separated from the torso and light stays consistent.
suitableUses: Explicit: folk-tale or theatrical moments, and narrative fables, cultural storytelling, or theatrical intros when paired with style-091. Inferred: narrative and theatrical content suits the silhouette medium. Suitability for product, data-heavy, or explanatory content is unspecified.
limitations: The source does not specify aspect ratio, duration, or resolution; example values are optional. Colored rig parts and exposed joint gaps should be avoided, and rubbery stretch is not permitted. Two-color contrast checks do not prove readability over textures, video, or animated light. Physical puppetry must be distinguished from simulated appearance.
palette: Suggested tokens: background #EFE0BC as the warm screen and foreground #272821 as silhouette ink, a monochrome pair with gradients disabled. These are authored suggestions; task, brand, or approved colors override them. Contrast is 11.375:1, meeting the 4.5 normal-text target in two-color checks only. Add no accent hues; use opacity or hatching for tone.
motionAndInteraction: Animate poses, shadow size, and stage movement while keeping one consistent light source. Layer silhouettes and the screen separately, with defined puppet pivots and arcs. Motion cadence is not mandated, and stop-motion stepping should not be imposed from the style name. Scroll or hover interaction is unspecified; video motion is driven by composition time.
audio: Audio is unspecified for this style, and no fixed music, voice, or mandatory layer is assigned. The audio direction is a topic-driven suggestion only. Inferred: a restrained theatrical or folk-tale tone may suit this style, but no tempo or instrument is given. Speech intelligibility, balance, and absence of clipping must be verified in the final video.
assetRequirements: The source requires layered silhouettes, a separate translucent screen layer, and defined puppet pivots. No source artwork, fonts, or audio files are supplied. Motion references motion-012 and motion-015 are optional and need scene-level fit checks. Any authorized audio must be sourced separately, and stateful simulations should be cached before rendering.
combinations: Shadow Puppetry alone suits folk-tale or theatrical moments. Hybrid one adds style-091 for puppet rigging with pivots, joint limits, and replacement poses, using #272821 on #EFE0BC with limbs never overlapping the torso. Hybrid two adds style-038 for static single-ink wash backdrops made only from foreground opacity. Avoid colored rig parts and generic splashes, and stay within two tokens.
productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default pipeline for composition and export; Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation applies. SVG and Canvas 2D create the silhouettes and screen. GSAP provides seekable timing, and Motion is optional. chroma.js validates colors and contrast. Verification requires checking decoded key frames, full playback, and audio sync. Blender Silhouette Scenes is listed as an alternative.
